description: False-colour infrared satellite imagery showing a rural landscape with a linear settlement and surrounding agricultural and forest areas, annotated with land cover codes and distance criteria for delineation. The image depicts a main linear settlement outlined in yellow and labelled "1110" (likely representing Discontinuous Urban Fabric, related to CLC+ class 1.1.1 Urban areas). Surrounding this are agricultural fields, with one larger area of agricultural land labelled "2320" (likely Complex Cultivation Patterns, CLC code 232). In the top right, a patch of forest is labelled "3110" (likely Broad-leaved Forest, CLC code 311). Arrows indicate two distance criteria for separating or aggregating features within the settlement: one area marked as "> 50 m" between delineated parcels and another as "< 50 m". This image is an example demonstrating land cover mapping rules, potentially related to Minimum Mapping Unit (MMU) exceptions and spatial aggregation for Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS) products such as CORINE Land Cover (CLC) or CLC+.
